sources.name: jobs.ac.uk
sources.note: Now queried by field, not just the generic word 'postdoctoral'. There is NO working civil-engineering category URL — /categories/civil-engineering-jobs/1 returns 404; use keyword search. The keyword 'earthquake engineering' returned literally 0 jobs; 'seismic' returned 2, both geoscience; 'geotechnical' returned 5, none postdoc-level. Search pages omit the year on dates, so years are marked derived.

sources.name: AcademicPositions.com
sources.note: The engineering feed (188 postdocs, 7 pages) is now polled and keyword-filtered. There is NO civil-engineering field slug — /field/civil-engineering silently renders an empty directory shell rather than 404ing, which is a trap for a scraper: detect it by the absence of /ad/ links, not by HTTP status. Individual ad pages intermittently return 403; where that happened, fields were taken from the listing page only and the rest left null.

sources.name: THE unijobs
sources.note: A dedicated /listings/civil-engineering/ route exists (39 hits) and is now polled — this was missed on the first build. Expired ads stay in the listings, so status is computed from the deadline rather than assumed. Listing cards often omit salary and closing date; those come from the individual page.

sources.name: researchersjob.com
sources.note: Now searched by field. The ?s= search works for every term tried. The site has NO engineering category — navigation is by position type only. Result: ZERO Indian structural/civil/earthquake postdocs currently listed. Its 'structural' hits are all structural biology or structural causal modelling; its civil hits are faculty posts or foreign PhD scholarships.

sources.name: IndiaBioscience
sources.note: Life sciences only — will never carry structural engineering. Retained for completeness. Deadlines render without a year, so deadline is left null.

sources.name: IIT Delhi
sources.note: Institute Post Doctoral Fellow scheme explicitly names Civil Engineering and Applied Mechanics among eligible departments. Links to PDF advertisements; no HTML permalink exists.

sources.name: IIT Kanpur — Civil Engineering
sources.note: Departmental postdoc page, added specifically for this field. States applications are accepted year-round with no fixed deadline, so deadline and stipend are null.

sources.name: IIT Roorkee
sources.note: Added for this field. Its live project-jobs board has two Civil Engineering openings but both are Project Associate, below postdoc level, so they are excluded.

sources.name: JREC-IN Portal (Japan)
sources.note: QUARANTINED BY CONTROL PROBE. Requests for three deliberately invalid job IDs each returned complete, plausible postings instead of an error; two were byte-identical. The site executes search via POST with server-side session state and renders rows client-side, so a plain GET returns no listings and the fetch layer confabulated. Zero records accepted. Needs a JS-capable browser fetch.

sources.name: Academic Jobs Online
sources.note: Rows were readable with [POSTDOC] tags and deadlines, but no per-row hyperlink survived the fetch. Records without an individual posting URL are rejected by policy, so all were dropped. Every visible row was also long expired.

sources.name: IIT Delhi IRD vacancies board
sources.note: DEAD DATA. Every row carries a 2017 advertisement number (IITD/IRD/117-125/2017) with deadlines in July-August 2017. Also serves a TLS certificate that does not match its own hostname. Nothing taken from it.

sources.name: Indian engineering-postdoc aggregators
sources.note: No Indian aggregator covers engineering postdocs. Four candidates were fetched and checked. FacultyPlus is the closest — real research-associate and postdoc index pages including engineering institutions — but across ~40 current listings not one was civil/structural/earthquake, and its civil-engineering page is entirely teaching-faculty ads from private colleges. FacultyTick's civil tag holds only administrative posts. ScholarshipDB's structural-engineering-in-India page returns Springer Nature editorial jobs and is worthless. The realistic route for this field in India is per-institution project-position pages, not aggregators.

sources.name: EURAXESS
sources.note: robots.txt ends with 'Disallow: /jobs/*' and 'Disallow: /*?', closing the search and every detail page plus all pagination. Also disallows */api/*, */rest/*, /*?_format=json. Not polled. This is the single biggest coverage loss for European structural engineering — the only sanctioned integration is institutions pushing XML in, via support@euraxess.eu.

sources.name: Nature Careers
sources.note: robots.txt disallows /naturecareers/jobs/search and /naturecareers/jobsrss/, and issues 'Disallow: /' for User-Agent anthropic-ai and ClaudeBot by name. Not polled.

sources.name: FindAPostDoc
sources.note: 403 on robots.txt and every listing path. The one route that responds served postings with 2017 deadlines. Rejected as a stale-data hazard.

sources.name: HigherEdJobs
sources.note: Incapsula WAF challenge on both the RSS path and search. Not pollable without dedicated anti-bot handling.

sources.name: ANRF / CSIR / DST (India, government)
sources.note: ANRF renders calls into empty client-side containers. CSIR-HRDG's front door is a language-selection splash and its RA page is a static guidelines document with no announcement stream. DST's announcement list carries no dates at all. Payloads are PDFs. No per-position stream exists to ingest.
